page.overview:
Who is Leophyne?

Leophyne is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. She is the member of the Passage of the Unbound who stole the Cradle of the Sleepless. Leophyne is the antagonist during the Tank role quests in the Dawntrail expansion.

Leophyne was born of noble blood, but she always despised the traditions of Ishgard and the responsibilities that came with her position. Though a formidable Temple Knight, known for her prowess in combat and skill with mounts, she often defied the norm by spending nights in the gambling halls, until one day she fell asleep on guard duty, allowing her allies to be slaughtered by dragons. For this failure, she was expelled from the Temple Knights and stripped of her title..}} After her expulsion, her whereabouts became unknown and her name becoming synonymous with disgrace among her former comrades..|name=The Narwhal Beckons}}

Leophyne was one of Apyaahi's guests who joined her villainous group, the Passage of the Unbound. Once all those invited to join the organization gathered at Tuliyollal, Apyaahi revealed the existence of sacred treasures around Tural. These artifacts contain the essence of fearsome beasts called Tural Vidraal, and said that with the power of the artifacts they could achieve their goal..}} Following Apyaahi's instructions, Leophyne came to the village of Xak Tural, posing as a scholar interested in the Cradle of the Sleepless. She managed to deceive the villagers and steal the artifact, which allowed its wielder to transfer fatigue to another and induce sleep. After the theft, she fled to Ishgard with the Cradle, intending to use its power for her own purposes.

Back in Ishgard, Leophyne used the Cradle's powers to attempt to tarnish the reputation of the Temple Knights, ridiculing several knights by making them sleep on duty. Leophyne also released several criminals who held a grudge against the Temple Knights to be her henchmen. Eventually Leophyne and her henchmen confronted the Warrior of Light and Tentoawa who were trying to retrieve the Cradle. Tentoawa attempted to confront her but was quickly overwhelmed by the artifact's power and fell into a deep sleep..}}
